payload.rationale: The packet grounds the once-per-term WET requirement and its temporal hook (first springtime after the January 1, 2022 effective date) and identifies the FY2025 window, but it does not establish whether the once-per-term WET test remains outstanding. Per the oracle relation contract, ACCEPT requires establishing FY2025 as a required WET year and REJECT requires establishing it as not required; neither burden is met. The packet explicitly records the absence of performance evidence, so unsupported semantic closure (treating FY2025 as automatically required or automatically not required) is not warranted. UNRESOLVED is the correct disposition.
